reviews_5s:
I purchased these to use for storing common washing items on my kitchen and laundry room counters. One holds my dishwasher detergent packs (Seventh Generation) and the other holds dry oxygen bleach for clothes (OxiClean).

These containers work extremely well for the purpose I use them for. The glass isn't too thin or thick; they're of substantial weight but not too heavy to lift when filled with items. The lids lift off easily so I can pick up a lid with one hand and reach in with my other hand to retrieve the product by hand or with a scoop. They're not airtight and that's what I want.

NOTE: These are NOT made for storing perishable food items and they're clearly not advertised to be. Customers complaining about this product not having a seal haven't read the advertisement correctly. Nowhere in the ad does it state it has a seal. If you want a container with a seal then you'll need to look for that specific wording in the title or description of the item. If neither states it explicitly, then it won't be airtight. If you're not looking for airtight glass containers, I think you'll be pleased with this purchase.I use these as an alternative to a bread box. They keep the bread fresh, while the bread (or any other food you choose) is being stored in nothing but glass!I currently am using these for my laundry room . I love the design of them , i put my soap pods , oxi clean and scent beads in them . They are great quality , and look good on the shelfs when people enter or walk passThese are a great value for the price. Thick glass, heavy weight, perfect for storing dry goods. I used them for rice and beans in my pantry. They do not seal but they lids fit the canister well. I will be buying another set for laundry items.I absolutely love these glass jars! I bought them to store my powdered laundry soap, and they are perfect. They look beautiful on the shelf, keep everything fresh, and add such a clean, organized feel to my laundry room. The quality is excellent — thick, sturdy glass. They’re exactly what I was looking for. Highly recommend if you want something functional and stylish!These were purchased for flour, sugar and other essential baking ingredients that I buy in bulk. I love the large lid openings and capacity.I bought 2 of these jars. They look good. Perfect size for the coffee bar. We use them for our coffee cups and expresso cups!We have friends staying with us who lost their home and everything they own in the Altadena Fire, the daughters birthiday soi gave a party, these jars are beautiful. I used one for candy and one for coffee in the kitchen. I just reordered another set of 2 one gallon jars today

reviews_1s:
Horrible. No seal. What is the point of having no seal? This is NOT airtight as a result of having absolutely no seal to it. My return window has closed so now I have to purchase another option with an actual seal to it so that the items placed in it will not spoil.Finally took these two out of the box and filled them with flour this week. Today, opened and closed one to grab a cup of flour and the top cracked. Honestly I was surprised as the glass looks fairly thick and durable. But we definitely didn’t bang it around and one the first real use of grabbing a cup of flour and returning the lid, it broke and glass shards went into the organic flour I just ordered and had put in the container. The other glass container, as there were two, is fine as we haven’t used it yet. If I knew how delicate these were I’d have exchanged or returned them. I wanted something usable, not just for show. We have all glass containers but this brand was the only one we’ve found that breaks instantly.
Unfortunately it’s too late to return. So taking a loss on the product and on the expensive flour I bought to store in it.
Not great.
Disappointed.This 2 gallon glass jar arrived in hundreds of pieces. The outer box was in perfect condition. The jar sat in a form fitting cardboard bottom. Then there was a form fitting cardboard top. There was no foam or styrofoam cushioning at all. I don’t see how any glass container could arrive in one piece when packaged this way.
I took the refund & ordered a 2 gallon plastic jar instead. I could not find another glass option. Very disappointed, I always prefer glass storage to plastic.

Anchor Hocking- you can do better!Heavy duty but not good for perishable food.
The lid has no seal and it does not fit snugly nor evenly on the jar topLid doesn't stay on right. Very overpriced.The Anchor Hocking site on Amazon proudly states that these jars are made in the USA. NOT!!! They arrived in cardboard boxes marked "Made in China." There is no marking indicating they're even the Anchor Hocking brand. I was specifically looking for USA made storage jars. Really FALSE advertising! I called Anchor Hocking and they said ALL of their products are USA made, and to buy only when seller and shipper is Amazon. I did that, and they came in box marked "Anchor Hocking", Made in USA, and stamped "Union made by United Steel Workers." The glass was heavier and better made. This seller has changed their name 3 times in last 2 weeks, and are stealing jobs from Americans.Description is misleading and should be changed. The glass lids do not have a cork seal as described in product information. The lids fit very loosely in the jar and move noisily. Would not have purchased if I had knownWas very excited to get these for a party I’m having but they came chipped! Packaging was not harmed, just the jarsThese jars are either made too thin or there's something wrong with the glass, as the lids chip easily from normal use. Both of these were chipped within the first month, with glass shards falling into the food. Other canisters that I've purchased hold up fine. These are not worth the money, and are a danger to kids and family!These jars are beautiful and feel well-made, but one arrived without a lid, which is a deal-breaker for me. If I didn't need to use these next week, I'd have returned them. Here's to hoping the vendor sees this and sends me the 2nd lid!
